CARE THAT MOVES WITH YOU

Electrotherapy

Understand the options before you decide.

Electrotherapy is a broad term for treatments using electrical or other physical energy. Examples used in physiotherapy include TENS and therapeutic ultrasound, which work in different ways.

UNDERSTANDING YOUR OPTIONS

What is involved?

Ask which specific treatment is being proposed, why it is being considered, and what evidence supports it for your symptoms. Equipment-based treatment should be discussed in the context of your overall care.

What to expect

Your appointment is a chance to ask questions, share your priorities, and understand the proposed approach.

  • Clarification of the device and proposed treatment
  • A review of suitability and health history
  • Discussion of expected effects and alternatives

Before your visit

Wear comfortable clothing and bring any relevant referral letters, scan reports, or instructions from another healthcare professional. Make a note of the questions you would like to ask.

Your questions, answered.

Are all types of electrotherapy the same?+

No. Different devices have different uses and considerations. Confirm which type is available and suitable during your assessment.

How many sessions will I need?+

The plan depends on your assessment, goals, and response. Discuss a review point with your physiotherapist rather than assuming a fixed number of visits.

How do I make an enquiry?+

Use the enquiry button on this page to prepare a request with this treatment selected. Online booking is not connected yet, so a downloaded enquiry does not reserve an appointment.
